headline: GOLD SLIDES to $4,564 as Trump's 'Project Freedom' Ship Plan Cools Safe-Haven Demand
snippet: Gold dropped to $4,564 per ounce on May 4 after President Trump announced 'Project Freedom,' a U.S. initiative to escort non-combatant ships through the Strait of Hormuz, reducing the geopolitical risk premium that had been supporting safe-haven prices. Silver fell to $73.83 as firmer U.S. economic data and a stronger dollar added additional headwinds.

headline: POWER METALLIC Drills 39m of 5.66% Copper and 17.45m of 9.47% CuEq at Quebec's Nisk
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (TSX-V: PNPN) released high-grade assays from its winter 2026 Lion Zone drill program at the Nisk polymetallic project in Quebec, with standout intercepts of 17.45m grading 9.47% CuEqRec and 39m grading 5.66% CuEqRec — among the strongest results reported from the system. A Mineral Resource Estimate is on track for Q3 2026, with CEO Terry Lynch calling the Lion Zone's core 'very positive' going into the MRE.

headline: USA RARE EARTH Rockets 72% in April: Inside the $2.8B Serra Verde Deal Challenging China's Lock
snippet: USA Rare Earth (USAR) surged 72% in April after announcing a $2.8 billion agreement to acquire Serra Verde Group — the only producer outside Asia supplying all four magnetic rare earth elements (Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb) at commercial scale — via a U.S. government-backed 15-year offtake agreement. This Motley Fool analysis examines the strategic rationale and whether the premium is justified heading into a Q3 2026 close.

headline: WHO'S WINNING the 2026 Junior Mining Exploration Race? New Analysis Sizes Up Africa vs. Canada
snippet: African Mining Online's May 4 analysis examines which geographic regions are capturing junior mining exploration dollars in 2026 and whether African jurisdictions are becoming meaningfully competitive with Canada and Australia for exploration capital. The piece weighs lower discovery costs per ounce in Africa against the jurisdictional risk premiums that still give pause to conservative retail investors.

headline: 100+ NEW Lithium Mining Projects Proposed Across the U.S. as Battery Metal Race Accelerates
snippet: More than 100 new lithium extraction projects have been filed across the United States in 2026, driven by surging EV and grid-storage demand, with at least six major projects expected to reach production by 2030. The proposal wave follows the USGS estimate of 2.3 million metric tons of recoverable lithium in Appalachia — enough to replace 328 years of current U.S. import volumes — though permitting and infrastructure remain major hurdles.

headline: COPPER ENDS Five-Session Slide: China PMI Bounce and Iran Supply Fears Lift Metal to $5.94
snippet: Copper futures ended a multi-session losing streak as stronger Chinese manufacturing data and renewed Strait of Hormuz supply concerns triggered a bounce, with the metal climbing to $5.94 per pound on May 5 — up 2.44% on the session. China's decision to halt sulfuric acid exports starting in May, a critical input for roughly 15% of global copper production, is adding a new supply wildcard to an already tight market.

headline: BILLIONS Flow Into Mining as Institutional Funds Bet Big on a New Commodity Supercycle
snippet: Major institutional funds are making multibillion-dollar bets on a commodity supercycle, targeting structural deficits in copper, uranium, and critical minerals driven by AI infrastructure demand and the global energy transition. The surge in fund flows into the mining sector is raising hopes for improved capital access and re-rating potential for junior explorers on the TSX-V and ASX.

headline: NEWMONT Q1 Miss: Motley Fool Says Long-Term Investors Should Have Seen This Coming
snippet: Newmont's first-quarter results disappointed the market, but this May 2 Motley Fool analysis argues the shortfall was predictable given the company's ongoing portfolio transformation via asset divestitures and production ramp-ups. The piece asks whether Newmont's blue-chip status in gold mining still justifies a valuation premium when gold itself is trading above $4,500 per ounce.

headline: COT REPORT: Gold Speculators Hold Elevated Net Longs as Metal Consolidates Above $4,500
snippet: GoldSeek's May 1 Commitment of Traders breakdown for gold, silver, and the U.S. dollar index shows futures speculators holding elevated net long positions in precious metals despite recent price consolidation. The data suggests institutional conviction in the gold bull thesis remains intact, though stretched positioning could amplify any correction if geopolitical risk premiums ease further.

headline: GOLD STOCKS AWAITING a Catalyst — GoldSeek Weekly Examines Why Miners Are Lagging the Metal
snippet: GoldSeek's Issue #72 weekly mining roundup finds gold, silver, and mining equities in a holding pattern, with the sector waiting on a decisive catalyst — whether a fresh gold price breakout, a Fed policy shift, or geopolitical resolution. The piece examines why mining stocks have underperformed the gold price in the near term and what conditions could trigger a catch-up rally.
